# Citation Styler

> > Citation Styler provides custom CSL citation styles for Zotero, enabling universities and publishers to implement standardized referencing formats.

Citation Styler is a specialized service built around Zotero and Citation Style Language (CSL), offering pre-built citation styles for German universities, custom style development, and expert training. The platform is maintained by Patrick O'Brien, a CSL and Zotero specialist, and serves academic institutions, publishers, and individual researchers.

## Key Topics

- Zotero
- Citation Style Language (CSL)
- CSL Styles
- Deutsche Zitierweise
- Custom Citation Styles

## Core Services

- [Citation Styler Homepage](https://citationstyler.com): Homepage introducing Citation Styler's CSL citation styles for Zotero
- [Citation Styler (English)](https://citationstyler.com/en): English language homepage for Citation Styler's Zotero integration
- [Zotero Citation Styles](https://citationstyler.com/zitierstile): Main product page showcasing available Zotero citation styles
- [Custom Citation Styles](https://citationstyler.com/stil-nach-mass): Custom citation style service page for universities and publishers
- [Zotero Training & Mentoring](https://citationstyler.com/zotero-schulung-training-mentoring): One-on-one Zotero training and mentoring service offering

## University Citation Styles

- [FOM Hochschule Citation Style](https://citationstyler.com/zitierstile/zitierstil-fom-hochschule): FOM Hochschule citation style for Zotero with footnotes support
- [Deutsche Zitierweise](https://citationstyler.com/zitierstile/zitierstil-deutsche-zitierweise): German citation style (Deutsche Zitierweise) for Zotero
- [Apollon Hochschule Citation Style](https://citationstyler.com/zitierstile/zitierstil-apollon-hochschule-der-gesundheitswirtschaft): Citation style for Apollon Hochschule der Gesundheitswirtschaft
- [DHBW Stuttgart Citation Style](https://citationstyler.com/zitierstile/zitierstil-duale-hochschule-baden-wuerttemberg-stuttgart-finanzwirtschaft): DHBW Stuttgart Finanzwirtschaft citation style for Zotero
- [Hochschule Fresenius Citation Style](https://citationstyler.com/zitierstile/zitierstil-hochschule-fresenius-university-of-applied-sciences): Hochschule Fresenius citation style for Zotero
- [FAU Erlangen-Nürnberg Citation Style](https://citationstyler.com/zitierstile/zitierstil-friedrich-alexander-universitat-erlangen-nurnberg-mhba): FAU MHBA citation style for Zotero
